Class PlacementDTO

java.lang.Object
com.sunilos.common.BaseDTO
com.sunilos.dto.PlacementDTO
All Implemented Interfaces:
DropdownList, Serializable, Comparable<BaseDTO>
@Entity public class PlacementDTO extends BaseDTO
Placement POJO class. It encapsulates a Student's campus placement outcome with a Company. It is persistent object.
